title: Friern Barnet & Whetstone
intro: North London's edge, where the suburbs give way to the fields and lanes of Totteridge, with brook-side walks and a Victorian landmark turned into homes.

items.name: Darland's Lake
items.blurb: A small lake hidden in woodland below Totteridge, looked after as a nature reserve, with paths along the Folly Brook.

items.name: Dollis Valley Greenwalk
items.blurb: A long footpath that follows the Dollis Brook through meadows and woodland strips from Mill Hill towards Hampstead Garden Suburb.
items.tip: Good for a bike ride with children: it is mostly flat.

items.name: Totteridge village and common
items.blurb: A green-belt village of big houses, hedges and fields along Totteridge Lane, with an ancient yew in St Andrew's churchyard that is thought to be one of London's oldest trees.
items.tip: Walk the lane west from Totteridge & Whetstone station for the countryside feel.

items.name: Coppetts Wood
items.blurb: Ancient woodland and meadow by the North Circular, a Local Nature Reserve with the Glebelands next door.
items.tip: A surprisingly wild walk only minutes from the shops.

items.name: Friary Park
items.blurb: Friern Barnet's main park, on the grounds of an old house, with a café, playgrounds and a stream running through.
items.tip: The café and play area are by the main house.
